title: The Master's Warning
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji had yet to digest that fateful prophecy, a blood-red rift tore across the sky beyond the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate—an omen that only appears when a Transcendent Nascent Stage expert strikes with full force.

text.content: The atmosphere in the Council Hall was lively, Chen Ji wore his usual humble smile while his mind raced through the aftermath of the Han Lie incident. Yet in the next moment, an urgent voice-transmitting Jade Slip pierced through the air, and in his mind, Mo Xiansheng's aged yet commanding voice resounded—'Return quickly! Something major has happened at Tianqing Sect! The Han Lie matter has other secrets!' Chen Ji's pupils contracted—the voice carried a rare, unprecedented solemnity.

Chen Ji rose and took his leave almost the instant he heard the warning, his decisiveness drawing slight glances from the surrounding Inner Disciples—this ordinarily sluggish waste of a servant disciple was reacting today with an unfamiliar swiftness. Su Qingyao's gaze lingered on his retreating figure, her brow furrowed, but she offered no inquiry. That string in her heart had tightened yet again.

As Chen Ji pushed open that dust-laden meditation room, an unprecedented pressure slammed into him. It was neither killing intent nor hostility, but rather a might seemingly descended from the Nine Heavens—transcending all his previous understanding. Almost by pure instinct, he channeled the Tianji Record's aura to resist, yet his knees nearly buckled. In the chamber's depths, a phantasmal figure hovered mid-air—that was Mo Xiansheng, yet not quite the gentle remnant soul from memory.

dialogue.content: You've arrived. Good. This remnant soul of your master has been suppressed until now, finally finding the moment to speak.

text.content: The spiritual pressure emanating from Mo Xiansheng churned like dark currents in an abyss. Chen Ji could barely distinguish its magnitude through his Tianji Record instincts—Transcendent Nascent Stage? No, the richness and profundity of this aura far exceeded any records about Transcendent Nascent Stage. His heart churned with shock, yet his expression maintained appropriate astonishment. Master, you are...

dialogue.content: Transcendent Nascent Stage? Child, the Transcendent Nascent Stage you have witnessed represents merely the shallowest puddle on the path of cultivation. At my peak, this remnant soul once personally suppressed the combined assault of three Transcendent Nascent Stage pinnacle experts.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The collaborative attack of three Transcendent Nascent Stage pinnacle experts meant Mo Xiansheng's former cultivation was at least beyond Transcendent Nascent Stage—possibly even the legendary Void Return Stage! This remnant soul who had played the role of a kind master for five years possessed such terrifying strength? He suddenly understood why the other always revealed only fragments—no one of such caliber could afford to be detected, lest the consequences prove unthinkable.

dialogue.content: The first generation master of the Tianji Record was Chen Xuan—the last prophet I personally witnessed grow to maturity.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice seemed to emanate from antiquity, each word carrying millennia of vicissitude. Chen Ji held his breath, knowing the truly crucial words were about to come. Chen Xuan... wasn't that precisely the name mentioned in the founding texts of the Tianqing Sect? Legend claimed he perished in a catastrophic upheaval, with the Tianji Record shattering into countless fragments. Master, the Chen Xuan you mention—how does he relate to your disciple...

dialogue.content: The blood flowing within you shares the same source as his.

choice.prompt: The truth of Chen Xuan's bloodline erupted like thunder in Chen Ji's mind. How should he respond to this sudden mystery of identity?

choices.description: Directly ask about the specific relationship between yourself and Chen Xuan, and how this bloodline affects the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Gain key information about one's own bloodline
choices.risk_hint: The master may only reveal partial truths

dialogue.content: Chen Xuan had three sons—your lineage is the deliberately erased youngest branch. The Tianji Record selects its master based on Heavenly Fate, never bloodline. But perhaps your ability to endure the fragment's erosion stems precisely from carrying a prophet's blood.

choices.description: Suppress the churning tempest in one's heart and continue listening from a bystander's perspective
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to proactively ask questions
choices.visible_reward: Allow the master to voluntarily reveal more hidden information
choices.risk_hint: May hear truths one prefers not to know

dialogue.content: You're quite composed. Very well, some matters should have been told to you earlier—the Tianji Record is no artifact mortal hands could create. It is a fragment of Heaven's Will projected into the mortal realm, and Chen Xuan was merely the first person it chose.

text.content: A fragment of Heaven's Will's projection? Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill ascend his spine. He had always believed he merely possessed a treasure left behind by predecessors, never suspecting it could be related to that elusive Heaven itself. Mo Xiansheng seemed to pierce through his thoughts, remarking coolly: You thought those prophecies came from nowhere? Every glimpse of the future is borrowing from that entity towering above all beings.

dialogue.content: But calling you back today was not for this.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's expression suddenly turned grave, that beyond-Transcendent Nascent Stage pressure diminishing yet growing deeper. He waved his hand, and a blurry map materialized in the void—a terrain of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds, yet shrouded in eerie black mist, its full picture obscured. Within that secret realm, something is awakening. The aura this master sensed... even at my full power, I never encountered its like.

dialogue.content: Master's meaning is... even you cannot handle it?

text.content: Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, his illusory eyes flickering with an unprecedented wariness Chen Ji had never witnessed. That was no ordinary emotion brought by a formidable foe, but rather an instinctive reverence when confronting something transcending comprehension. What this master advises—only one word: retreat. But I also know, child... you will not listen.

dialogue.content: Go, but remember—in that secret realm, some things kill at a single glance.

choice.prompt: Facing the master's severe warning, Chen Ji must choose—whether to risk entering the secret realm or seek another path.

choices.description: Bring protective artifacts from the master and formulate thorough plans before acting
choices.visible_reward: Increases survival probability and grants more preparation time
choices.risk_hint: The secret realm's anomaly may occur at any moment

dialogue.content: This is what this master wished to see. Remember, the Tianji Record grants you the power of foresight, not prescience—what you can see is always only what it wishes you to see.

choices.description: Since the crisis has arrived, take the initiative to seize the advantage
choices.visible_cost: Extremely high risk; Heavenly Fate Value may be damaged
choices.visible_reward: Gain core intelligence about the secret realm and seize initiative

dialogue.content: Your temper... very well. This master cannot stop you, but you must accept this item—it once shielded Chen Xuan from a fatal blow. Now this master entrusts it to you.

choices.description: Secretly contact Ye Qing and others to form an alliance before entering the secret realm
choices.visible_cost: Expose some trump cards; allies may betray
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Demonic Path's mist cover and reduce the risk of Tianji Record detection
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's true stance remains questionable

dialogue.content: You dare even use the Demonic Path's saint? Good, very good. If Chen Xuan had your methods back then, perhaps... very well, go. The secrets of the Tianji Record run far deeper than you imagine.

text.content: Before his words ended, a withered palm appeared in Mo Xiansheng's hand, revealing an ancient jade pendant. The pendant was entirely black, yet flowing across its surface were heart-palpitating golden纹路, as if some primordial power was sealed within. Chen Ji sensed a familiar aura—the flavor of the Tianji Record's本体, yet distinctly different—more violent, more... dangerous. This item is called the Heavenly Fate Lock Heart Pendant, forged by Chen Xuan using his own lifespan as the catalyst and Tianji Record fragments as the core.

dialogue.content: It can shield you from one fatal attack—only once.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of weariness: When Chen Xuan fell, it was this that preserved his final wisp of divine soul. Now this master entrusts this remnant pendant to you, hoping you... will not walk Chen Xuan's old path. The instant Chen Ji accepted the pendant, an icy force spread through his entire body from his palm, as if something awakened in the depths of his bloodline. He suddenly understood something—the master's words about "Chen Xuan's fall" might not have been a mere accident.
Child, everything this master could teach has been taught. The road ahead... you must walk it alone.

Mo Xiansheng's form began to tremble violently, that beyond-Transcendent Nascent Stage pressure receded like an ebbing tide, replaced by a decay Chen Ji had never witnessed. It turns out... to manifest this once, this master has burned the final strand of pure soul power within the remnant. From today onward, this master shall fall into eternal slumber, unless... you can make the Tianji Record one degree more complete. Chen Ji watched that gradually translucent figure, an ineffable sorrow surging in his heart.

dialogue.content: Your destiny has never rested in your own hands.
